narr: An upper low positioned over Mississippi brought widespread rain and thunderstorms across the area, generally from south to north. A couple instances of training thunderstorms brought several inches of rain to the Tuscaloosa and Selma areas, resulting in areas of street flooding. One thunderstorm just east of Selma briefly produced quarter-size hail in Burnsville.
ev: Heavy rainfall led to numerous instances of flooding in Selma. Flooded roadways included Broad St, Highland Ave, Dallas Ave, Alabama Ave, Water Ave, Mabry St, and Maxey St. A water rescue took place from a vehicle at Water and Maxey.
